spec.name: sprint47_qhour_open_crypto_v1
spec.hypothesis: At quarter-hour boundaries, periodic algorithmic flow (arXiv 2607.09426) makes the next 15m drift positive when the prior 15m return is positive and the prior taker-buy share exceeds 0.5 by imb_min. Boundary-timed entry; the share is a filter only. Adjacent to the closed standalone taker_imbalance family (sprint21-23), disclosed.
spec.power_argument: BTC and ETH, about 92 validation days, boundary entries with cap 10/day per symbol; expected validation n well above the 300 floor (to be confirmed by the auditor dry-run; if n<300, mark UNPOWERED and do not score). 15m sigma ~25-30bp gives SE ~1bp at n=1000, so min detectable edge at t=2 is ~2bp, below fees. T2 round trip is ~22bp+ with slippage, so PASS needs gross >~24bp; this fails under the null.
spec.prerequisite: C0/C1 pass on the current loader; auditor dry-run n>0 on research and validation; confirm the registrar does not reject on the closed-door term list.
